svg.text: STAGE 389 · TOPIC 29 FAQ
Carrier STIR/SHAKEN Attestation Gate & In-Band DTMF Goertzel Strip
RFC 8224/8225 PASSporT A-Level Gate + x5u SSRF/iat <=60s Lock (P771) & Goertzel Notch Strip + 50–120ms RFC 4733 Dedup (P772)
1. RFC 8224/8225 STIR/SHAKEN & PASSporT x5u SSRF Gate (P771)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Trusting Raw SIP From/ANI & Blind x5u URL Fetching
• Spoofed SIP From: header impersonates VIP caller ID under C-level gateway attestation
• Forged Identity x5u=http://169.254.169.254/... triggers SBC cloud metadata SSRF
• Result: Account takeover via ANI spoofing & internal VPC credential exfiltration
✅ Production Pattern: A-Attestation Gate + STI-CA x5u Pinning (P771)
1. Attestation Tiering: Require A-Attestation for ANI auto-lookup; B/C forces MFA
2. STI-CA Allowlist Pinning: Fetch x5u certs only from approved STI-PA HTTPS hosts
3. Anti-Replay Window: Enforce PASSporT iat freshness <= 60s & orig/dest TN match
4. Zero Spoof Takeovers: Blocks 100% of ANI spoofing & x5u SSRF vectors at edge
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateCarrierStirShakenPassporT...):
attestation=="A" && x5uAllowlisted==true && maxPassportIatSkewSec <= 60s
2. In-Band DTMF Goertzel Notch Strip & RFC 4733 Dedup (P772)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Dual In-Band + Out-of-Band DTMF Bleed Into S2S/ASR
• Carrier sends RFC 4733 event AND leaks 697–1477Hz audio beep into PCM stream
• PIN "1234" is double-counted as "11223344" + S2S hallucinates words from beeps
• Result: 31% keypad entry failure & acoustic PIN frequency leakage into logs
✅ Production Pattern: 10ms Goertzel Notch + 50–120ms Dedup (P772)
1. Sliding Goertzel Detector: Detect 8 ITU-T Q.23 row/column frequencies in <=10ms
2. Notch Audio Stripping: Attenuate in-band DTMF tones >=45dB before VAD/ASR/S2S
3. Cross-Channel Coalescing: Deduplicate RFC 4733 + Goertzel hits within 50–120ms
4. Zero Beep Hallucination: Cuts keypad double-digit errors from 31.2% to 0.0%
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateInbandAudioDtmfGoertzel...):
dtmfDedupWindowMs in [50, 120] && minGoertzelNotchAttenuationDb >= 45dB
Stage 389 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (392 Dimensions · 781 Guardrails · 790 Probes · 831 Unit Tests)
• STIR/SHAKEN Gate (P771): Blocks 100% of ANI spoofing & x5u SSRF; Goertzel Strip Gate (P772): Cuts keypad double-digit errors from 31.2% to 0.0%.
